**Swarm and Eval runs**

When credits run out during a Swarm or Eval run, blocked
work stops and you receive one credit-exhaustion prompt per run, or one per swarm when a swarm launches several runs at once. Com
pleted results are preserved. Buying credits does not automatically restart the run; start a new run once credits are available.\n

>

> turns are billed to MCPJam and

r all AI features runs those turns on its default AI model instead, and its\n> providers bill their tokens; see\n> [Organization A

I key policy](#organization-ai-key-policy).

held**. The balance is not\nempty: other requests from your organization were in flight and held the\nremaining credits until the
